He started by copying manga as a kid. He studied economics, finance, and marketing, then opened stores and ran the floor for big fashion brands. The work looked like a career. It did not feel like one. On December 25, still under 30 and home with his family, he had a stroke. He already knew Bitcoin. He had been stacking sats for years. The scare settled the question.
